Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Takeaways: BrightCommerce is focused on reducing inference cost for personalized recommendations and adding an internal fallback for latency spikes. Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data, EMEA latency SLOs, and a preference for rotating demo times to include APAC stakeholders.
- Next step: Technical deep dive + demo with engineering (incl. network/security) — target 60 minutes.
- Materials: product deck and a draft mutual action plan attached.

To make scheduling easier across your US/EU/APAC stakeholders, I put together a few rotating slot patterns (see below). Please tell me which pattern works best and any blackout dates. I've also included a Calendly link if you prefer to pick a time directly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/rd-demo

Rotating slot options (each rotates session time weekly so different regional reps join at reasonable hours):

1) Fixed US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening (Weekly rotate)
   - Week A: 09:00 PT / 17:00 BST / 00:00 SGT (next day)
   - Week B: 09:00 BST / 01:00 HKT / 01:00 SGT (swap hosts as needed)

2) Staggered overlap window (bi-weekly)
   - Option 1: 08:00 PT / 16:00 BST (best for US + EU)
   - Option 2: 22:00 PT / 06:00 BST / 13:00 SGT (best for EU + APAC)

3) Rotating three-week cadence (each week prioritizes one region)
   - Week 1: US-friendly slot
   - Week 2: EU-friendly slot
   - Week 3: APAC-friendly slot

If you're OK with any of the above I'll propose concrete dates (I can lock recurring rotating demo invites).

Attaching: redwood-product-deck.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — call felt productive. I'll follow up with proposed dates once I hear preferences.

Best,
Marissa
